# xTrac AI

> xTrac AI provisions a full AI organization for any business: autonomous agents for sales, support, operations and finance that execute real work 24/7 across WhatsApp, Instagram, email, web chat and voice. Enter your website URL, xTrac detects your industry and builds the team. Multi-agent, not a chatbot. No code, live in minutes. Built and operated by iEllipse Technologies (partnership firm, Mysuru, Karnataka, India).

Key facts:
- Product: an AI workforce (multi-agent platform), not a single chatbot. Departments: sales, support, operations, finance, HR, compliance.
- Channels: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram, any email provider, web chat, voice, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage, Microsoft Teams.
- Commerce integrations: Amazon (Seller + Ads), Shopify, Blinkit (India quick-commerce), payment and shipping gateways.
- Back office: ERP integration (SAP, ERPNext), Microsoft 365, Google Workspace.
- Pricing: Startup plan — free for 30 days (bring your own AI key, no card required), then USD 250/month flat for the whole AI team. Enterprise plan — custom pricing, on-premise or private-cloud deployment, data residency, SSO, named success partner.
- Security & compliance: GDPR and India DPDP Act 2023 compliant; AES-256 encryption in transit and at rest; Meta Tech Partner; Amazon Solution Provider; CASA certified; human-in-the-loop escalation for anything an agent cannot handle.
- Founders: Anil Kumar (Co-founder & CEO), Manoj Shetty (COO).
- Contact: support@xtrac.app · +91 6361823138 · Data Protection Officer: akumar@xtrac.app · #26 KHB Colony HIG I Group II Hootagalli, Mysuru, Karnataka 570018, India.

## FAQ

- Setup time: about five minutes — describe your business, connect a channel, agents go live.
- Technical team needed: no, fully no-code.
- When an agent can't help: it escalates to a human with full conversation context and a recommended next step.
- Sign in / get started: https://business.xtrac.app
